title: Viridian Therapeutics Reports $24.7 Million Q3 Lumvoa Revenue
summary: Viridian Therapeutics reported $24.7 million in Q3 2026 Lumvoa net product revenue and a $101.2 million net loss, with $955.2 million in cash.
body_markdown:
Gotrade News -[Viridian Therapeutics](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/vrdn/) (VRDN) reported third-quarter 2026 net product revenue of $24.7 million from Lumvoa, its approved thyroid eye disease treatment, on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, alongside a net loss of $101.2 million, according to[Viridian's official release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1590750/000119312526446200/d176865dex991.htm) filed with the SEC.

## Viridian Therapeutics Earnings Details


Net product revenue for Lumvoa was $24.7 million in the three months ended September 30, 2026, and Viridian did not record net product revenue in the same period of 2025, the release said. More than 100 patients were on therapy with Lumvoa as of September 30, 2026. "We are highly encouraged by the strength of Lumvoa's early launch in TED, which has exceeded expectations," said Steve Mahoney, President and Chief Executive Officer.
